about: One entry per trip report in archive/haz/triplog/. `segments` are the graph legs the trip walked: computed from the recorded track where one exists (a leg counts when at least half of its line lies within 30 m of the track), otherwise read from the prose. This is the join from a dated report to the legs it can carry observations for (#18).

triplogs.note: Sections are narrative ("The Hike Out", "Camp", "The Return"); legs come from the track.
No track. Mount Peeley via Cornucopia from the Peeley trailhead, same legs as the 2022-05-12 track.
Up Copper Camp Trail, a short way along Sheep Creek Trail (0U) to a campsite near water, overnight, then back the same way. 0U is only 29% covered and is not counted.
The "Deer Creek Connector" section is off-trail between Davey Gowan Camp and Bear Spring; not in the graph.
FR 269 and the Red Creek road walk are outside the graph; only the Verde River legs are in it.
Forest-road approach with a Verde River crossing, Fig Trail, then down Sheep Creek (the creek, not the trail) and a paddle down the Verde. Only Fig Trail is in the graph.
FR 18 / Red Creek road walk is outside the graph.
FR 194 road walk is outside the graph.
